title: From Questions to Decisions: Benchmarking How LLM Agents Acquire Decision-Relevant Information from Human Beings
abstract: arXiv:2611.13015v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly asked to make plans for people, such as scheduling drivers or assigning nurses. However, people's requests are often incomplete, and the supporting information for decision-making may be outdated, requiring agents to ask for clarification. Existing benchmarks typically provide fully specified problems or rely on uncalibrated LLM-simulated users, leaving this ability insufficiently tested. We introduce Ask2Decide, a benchmark of 43 planning tasks that evaluates whether agents ask for missing information that matters for their decisions. An operator holds facts absent from the agent's request and records, and optimization solvers determine which facts change the optimal plan. We also include similarly worded facts that leave the optimal plan unchanged to test whether agents distinguish useful information from irrelevant details. translated_title: 从问题到决策：基准测试LLM智能体如何从人类获取决策相关信息
translated_abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地被要求为人们制定计划，例如调度司机或分配护士。然而，人们的请求往往不完整，且用于决策的支持信息可能已过时，这要求智能体主动提问以获取澄清。现有的基准测试通常提供完全明确指定的问题，或依赖未经校准的LLM模拟用户，导致这种能力未得到充分检验。我们提出了Ask2Decide，这是一个包含43个规划任务的基准，用于评估智能体是否会询问对其决策至关重要的缺失信息。操作员掌握着智能体请求和记录中不存在的事实，并由优化求解器确定哪些事实会改变最优计划。我们还引入了措辞相似但不改变最优计划的事实，以测试智能体能否区分有用信息与无关细节。我们从19名参与者那里收集了79个交互会话，发现在不……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出Ask2Decide基准，通过43个由真人操作员和优化求解器支持的规划任务，评估LLM智能体能否主动向人类询问对决策至关重要的缺失信息，并区分有用信息与无关细节。
en_tdlr: Introduces Ask2Decide, a benchmark of 43 planning tasks with human operators and optimization solvers that evaluates whether LLM agents proactively ask humans for decision-relevant missing information and distinguish useful information from irrelevant details.
